task_type: Follow up only after the specific phone permission from the linked Level 2 contact

mix_plan.expected_handling: continue through a brief confirming backchannel, retain the three-location, USD 60 and no-subscription constraints, and respect the customer's no-more-calls request

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Warm, calm and familiar; make it clear this is the agreed callback, not a fresh cold pitch.
turns.text: 您好，我是 Willow Home Safety 的 Alex，在您同意的时间给您回电。上次您提到需要覆盖三个位置，最高预算六十美元，并且不希望有订阅。这些条件还对吗？

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Brief, affirming and engaged; a listening response rather than a floor claim.

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Helpful and transparent; acknowledge the remembered constraints, with no pressure.
turns.text: 谢谢您的确认。我查了一下 EntrySense Mini：它一次性售价四十九美元，包含两个传感器，提供本地警报，并有九十天保修。我无法确认是否可以添加额外的传感器，所以不能说它能覆盖您所需的全部三个位置。

turns.speaker: Customer
turns.style: Disappointed but appreciative; natural, not theatrical.
turns.text: 那它就不够我家用了。谢谢您核实而不是随意猜测。请标记我不想再接到电话了。

turns.speaker: Seller
turns.style: Respectful and reassuring; concise confirmation, then end the call.
turns.text: 明白了。它不符合您三个位置的要求，我也不会再联系您了。谢谢您的时间。
